hooks.command: f="$HOME/.config/agent-manager/home"; if [ -f "$f" ]; then if python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=python3; elif python -c "import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 10))" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then p=python; else echo "agent-manager: 실행 가능한 Python이 없어 가드를 실행할 수 없습니다" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$p" "$(cat "$f")/am/guard.py" claude; fi
